noise_adaptation.pdf.formula_or_claim: Actual causal variance learning from completed nonoverlapping past blocks. Each observation is corrected once; a fit updates only subsequent variances while retaining the streamed subspace belief. Known coordinate changes are aligned before block fitting. Curves show saved trajectory/episode summaries; variance bands are interquartile repeated-episode spread, not a posterior over variance. Future-task and pre-observation score intervals are pointwise 95\% intervals across independent episodes. Each page retains one predeclared noise-, motion-, or signal-power intervention. The contact supplementary density pages show one predeclared episode: panels (a,b) of the first density page use $t=32,96$, and panel (a) of the following density page uses $t=192$; pre-correction $A_t^-$ is converted to the wrist-frame normal law $q_{-A_t^-}$ with normalizer $\psi_1(-A_t^-)=\psi_2(A_t^-)-\operatorname{tr}(A_t^-)$. The three orthographic spheres share a density scale; panel (b) of the following density page shows the physical-query risk at all three checkpoints, $v_t^T(M_t^--(M_t^-)^2)v_t$ at the recorded physical query. This is individual belief uncertainty, distinct from the repeated-episode variance bands and from calibration. Empirical-Bayes plug-in scales omit their uncertainty and are outside the fixed-true-variance theorem.

Each observation is corrected once; a fit updates only subsequent variances while retaining the streamed subspace belief. Known coordinate changes are aligned before block fitting. Curves show saved trajectory/episode summaries; variance bands are interquartile repeated-episode spread, not a posterior over variance. Future-task and pre-observation score intervals are pointwise 95\% intervals across independent episodes. Each page retains one predeclared noise-, motion-, or signal-power intervention. The contact supplementary density pages show one predeclared episode: panels (a,b) of the first density page use $t=32,96$, and panel (a) of the following density page uses $t=192$; pre-correction $A_t^-$ is converted to the wrist-frame normal law $q_{-A_t^-}$ with normalizer $\psi_1(-A_t^-)=\psi_2(A_t^-)-\operatorname{tr}(A_t^-)$. The three orthographic spheres share a density scale; panel (b) of the following density page shows the physical-query risk at all three checkpoints, $v_t^T(M_t^--(M_t^-)^2)v_t$ at the recorded physical query. This is individual belief uncertainty, distinct from the repeated-episode variance bands and from calibration. Empirical-Bayes plug-in scales omit their uncertainty and are outside the fixed-true-variance theorem.

Contact observations are real. On the appended size pages, panels (a), (b), (c) show the state-ball chordal radius, clean scalar width and noisy scalar width, respectively. These are 128 independent test episodes per fixed checkpoint and regime.
